```{r}
# Load packages and data

library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(spData)
library(knitr)
library(gt)
library(kableExtra) # table formatting
library(spDataLarge) # spatial data
library(geodata) # spatial data
library(terra)
set_theme(theme_bw())
```


```{r}
# Load data

eez <- st_read('Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture/data/wc_regions_clean.shp')

depth <- rast('Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture/data/depth.tif')

# stack the rasters in the call for the data using c()
sst <- rast(c(
  'Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture/data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif',
  'Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture/data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif',
  'Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture/data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif',
  'Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture/data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif',
  'Prioritizing-potential-aquaculture/data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif'
))
```


```{r}
# Check crs
st_crs(eez) == crs(depth)
crs(sst) == crs(depth)
```

```{r}
# use project because sst is a raster
sst <- project(sst, crs(depth))
eez <- st_transform(eez, crs(depth))

```


```{r}
# Check crs
crs(eez) == crs(depth)
crs(sst) == crs(depth)
```


```{r}
# mean temps
mean_sst <- mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE)
plot(mean_sst)
sst_c <- mean_sst - 273.15
```


```{r}
# crop rasters to match extents
depth_crop <- crop(depth, sst_c)
```


```{r}
# resolutions match using bilinear resampling method
depth_resampled <- resample(depth_crop, sst_c, method = "bilinear")
plot(depth_resampled)

cat("After resampling:\n")
cat("Resolutions match:", all(res(depth_resampled) == res(sst_c)), "\n")
cat(
  "Origins match:    ",
  all(round(origin(depth_resampled), 8) == round(origin(sst_c), 8)),
  "\n"
)
cat("Extents match:    ", ext(depth_resampled) == ext(sst_c), "\n")
```

reclassify SST and depth data into locations that are suitable for oysters
hint: set suitable values to 1 and unsuitable values to 0
find locations that satisfy both SST and depth conditions
```{r}
# reclassify for suitable area
# Define a reclassification matrix
rcl_dep <- matrix(
  c(
    -Inf,
    -70,
    0,
    -70,
    0,
    1,
    0,
    Inf,
    0
  ),
  ncol = 3,
  byrow = TRUE
)

# Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1
depth_rcl <- terra::classify(depth_resampled, rcl = rcl_dep)
```


```{r}
# reclassify for suitable area
# Define a reclassification matrix
rcl_sst <- matrix(c(-Inf, 11, 0, 11, 30, 1, 30, Inf, 0), ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)

# Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1
sst_rcl <- terra::classify(sst_c, rcl = rcl_sst)


combined <- c(sst_rcl, depth_rcl)
```



```{r}
# find suitable locations with lapp
# multiply both of the reclassified

# Stack them, then apply a function of two arguments
suitable <- lapp(combined, fun = function(sst_rcl, depth_rcl) {
  sst_rcl * depth_rcl
})

plot(suitable)


# rasterize the eez data

eez_rast <- rasterize(eez, suitable, field = "rgn_id")
suitable <- mask(suitable, eez_rast)


suitable_areas <- cellSize(suitable, unit = "km", mask = TRUE)


suitable_zone_mask <- mask(suitable_areas, suitable, maskvalues = 0)

zone <- zonal(suitable_zone_mask, eez_rast, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
```

Join the zonal result back to eez by region with left_join(). Then arrange() by suitable area to rank the zones, make a kableExtra table, and create a tmap. The rubric requires a title, a legend with units, a scale bar, and a compass on the map.
```{r}
# join zones with suitable areas to the eez outlines by region id so we know where has the most suitable habitat area
eez_zones <- left_join(eez, zone, by = "rgn_id") |>
  arrange(desc(area)) # largest suitable area first

# map it!!!
tm_basemap("Esri.OceanBasemap") +
  tm_shape(eez_zones) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "area",
    fill_alpha = 0.7,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "brewer.yl_gn_bu"),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Amount of suitable area (km^2)"
    )
  ) +
  tm_title("Suitable Habitat Areas") +
  tm_scalebar(
    position = tm_pos_out(
      "center",
      "bottom"
    )
  ) +
  tm_compass(
    position = tm_pos_in(
      "left",
      "bottom"
    )
  )
```

make a table for the data

```{r}
eez_zones |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(rgn_id, area, area_km2) |>
  arrange(desc(area)) |>
  mutate(pct_suitable = area / area_km2 * 100) |>
  kable(
    digits = 1,
    col.names = c(
      "EEZ Region",
      "Suitable Area (km²)",
      "Total EEZ Area (km²)",
      "Suitable (%)"
    ),
    caption = "Suitable oyster aquaculture area by West Coast EEZ",
    booktabs = TRUE
  ) |>
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "hold_position"))
```


functionnnn
 
 ```{r}
 suitable_eez_map <- function(species_name, min_temp, max_temp, min_depth, max_depth) {

  # --- 1. Validate inputs (custom errors for the rubric) ---
  if (min_temp >= max_temp) stop("min_temp must be less than max_temp")
  if (min_depth >= max_depth) stop("min_depth must be less than max_depth")
  # if (min_depth < 0) stop("Enter depths as positive meters below sea level")

  # --- 2. Reclassify SST ---
  rcl_temp <- matrix(c(-Inf, min_temp, 0, 
                min_temp, max_temp, 1,  
                max_temp, Inf, 0),
              ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
              # Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1
temp_rcl <- terra::classify(sst_c, rcl = rcl_temp)

  # --- 3. Reclassify depth ---
  rcl_bathym <- matrix(c(-Inf, min_depth, 0, 
                min_depth, max_depth, 1,  
                max_depth, Inf, 0), 
              ncol = 3, byrow = TRUE)
              # Apply the matrix to reclassify the raster, making all cells 0 or 1
bathym_rcl <- terra::classify(depth_resampled, rcl = rcl_bathym)

  # --- 4. Combine conditions ---
depth_sst <- c(bathym_rcl, temp_rcl)

  # --- 5. Suitable area per EEZ ---
  # mask to eez_rast, cellSize(), mask out 0s, zonal(sum)
  suitable <- lapp(depth_sst, fun = function(temp_rcl, bathym_rcl) {
  temp_rcl * bathym_rcl
})

# rasterize the eez data

eez_rast <- rasterize(eez, suitable, field = "rgn_id")
suitable <- mask(suitable, eez_rast)

suitable_areas <- cellSize(suitable, unit = "km", mask = TRUE)
suitable_zone_mask <- mask(suitable_areas, suitable, maskvalues = 0)

zone <- zonal(suitable_zone_mask, eez_rast, fun = "sum", na.rm = TRUE)

  # --- 6. Join and map ---
  # left_join(eez, zone, by = "rgn_id")
  # tmap with paste(species_name, ...) in tm_title()
  # include a legend title with units, tm_scalebar(), tm_compass()
eez_zones <- left_join(eez, zone, by = "rgn_id") |>
  arrange(desc(area)) # largest suitable area first

map <- tm_basemap("Esri.OceanBasemap") +
  tm_shape(eez_zones) +
  tm_polygons(
    fill = "area",
    fill_alpha = 0.7,
    fill.scale = tm_scale_continuous(values = "brewer.yl_gn_bu"),
    fill.legend = tm_legend(
      title = "Amount of suitable area (km^2)"
    )
  ) +
  tm_title("Suitable Habitat Areas") +
  tm_scalebar(
    position = tm_pos_out(
      "center",
      "bottom"
    )
  ) +
  tm_compass(
    position = tm_pos_in(
      "left",
      "bottom"
    )
  )

  # --- 7. Return ---
return(map)
}
 ```



 ```{r}
 suitable_eez_map("crab", 8, 40, 0, 90)
 ```
